points: 1 Architecture: 111B dense decoder-only Transformer with SwiGLU, GQA (document masking), sliding-window and full attention interleaved 3:1 (RoPE on window layers, NoPE on full layers), parallel attention/FFN block, tied input/output embeddings, no bias terms (p. 3)

2 Disclosure: weights of Command A and Command R7B released under CC-BY-NC on HuggingFace (p. 2); not disclosed: pretraining token count, compute, layer/width counts, vocabulary size, data-mixture proportions

3 Pretraining recipe: µP/µTransfer tuning; JAX/GSPMD on H100s with DP+FSDP+SP; FP8 matmuls with FP32 master weights, plus BF16 steps to recover a small downstream loss; cooldown anneals LR from 2.5e-4 to 1e-6 over 50,000 steps, with context 8k (30k steps) then 32k/128k/256k (10k/5k/5k steps) (p. 4–5)

4 Post-training pipeline: Instruct model, then six SFT experts (Code, Safety, RAG, Math, Multilingual, Long-Context) merged into an SFT soup, then six RL experts merged into an RL soup, then polishing (best-of-N SFT, then offline SRPO and online CoPG alternated ping-pong); SRPO is a min-max self-refinement objective, CoPG a contrastive policy gradient equal to RLOO on-policy (p. 5–7)

5 Merging: linear weight averaging with manually searched weights (SLERP and task vectors no better); shared instruct initialisation; leave-one-out merges to find collisions; 1.8% average drop against the best expert, most metrics within 2.5%, code least preserved (p. 15–17, 34)

6 Efficiency and long context: serves on two A100/H100s at up to 156 tok/s (1.75x GPT-4o, 2.4x DeepSeek V3); KV cache 75% (8k) and 32.9% (128k) of Llama 3.3 70B's; RULER ≤128k average 95.0 vs Claude 3.5 Sonnet 95.4, 84.6 at 256k vs Gemini 1.5 Pro 91.6 (p. 1, 34)
7 Academic results (Tables 1/3): MATH 80.0 vs DeepSeek V3 70.2 / GPT-4o 68.5; MMLU 85.5 vs DeepSeek V3 88.5; GPQA 50.8 vs DeepSeek V3 59.1; IFEval 90.9 vs Llama 3.3 70B 92.1
8 Agents/RAG: Taubench 51.7 vs GPT-4o 51.2 (Table 1; retail/airline P@1 60.0/45.3 in Table 6); BFCL 63.8 vs GPT-4o 72.1; ChatRAGBench 72.9 vs GPT-4o 66.6

9 Multilingual and safety: NTREX COMET-20 average 68.8 vs GPT-4o 71.0; mArenaHard average win rate 53.4 vs DeepSeek V3; absolute safety 70.4 vs Claude 3.5 Sonnet 80.0 / Qwen 2.5 72B 71.4; XSTest over-refusal 1.1

10 Human and enterprise evaluation: pairwise win rates (general/reasoning/code) 50.4/51.4/46.8 vs GPT-4o and 49.0/49.3/54.7 vs DeepSeek V3 on ~800 internal prompts; polishing raised the GPT-4o win rates from 43.2/41.4/30.0; enterprise generative pass rate 94.2 vs Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2 84.2
